７ Note
The chat option is only available for incidents where we issued managed response.
Apart from using the in-portal chat, you can also engage in real-time chat conversations with
Defender Experts directly within Microsoft Teams. This capability provides you and your
security operations center (SOC) team more flexibility when responding to incidents that
require managed response. Learn more about turning on notifications and chat on Teams
Once you turn on chat on Teams, a new team named Defender Experts team is created and
the Defender Experts Teams app is installed in it. Each incident that requires your attention is
posted on this team's Managed response channel as a new post. To engage with our experts
(for example, ask follow-up questions about the investigation summary or actions published by
Defender Experts), use the Reply text bar to mention or tag @Defender Experts and type your
message. If you have issues setting up the Defender Experts channel or tagging @Defender
Experts, see troubleshooting Defender Experts app permissions in Microsoft Teams.
